cardData.t62: These beings are rumored to be able to change their forms using powerful dark magic. Be careful, though! You never know when once could be watching...

cardData.t69: If this Attack Damaged a Caster, Discard a Page at Random from their Chapter or place the top Page of their Spellbook under this Beastie.
